pairs.subject: fleet-orchestration
pairs.evidence: src/features/studio/studioStore.ts:669 The autonomous build chain stops as finished when the worker's own BUILD_PLAN phases all say 'done' (AUTO_INSTRUCTION tells it to 'mark all phases done'), so the run's completion rests on the worker's self-report and nothing parent-side reads the artifact.

techniques.evidence: src/features/studio/studioStore.ts:669 The stop condition is the model-authored phase list. No receipt, no decidable leaf and no UNVERIFIED outcome exist.

src/features/studio/studioStore.ts:111 There is only the enforced cap. AUTO_INSTRUCTION (line 135) carries no turn budget derived from it, and nothing counts how often the cap fired versus an elected stop.

src/features/studio/studioStore.ts:586 An empty reply is replaced with a fabricated 'Done.' bubble, a completion statement the session never sent. This is a reply text, not a registry status, so it is a borderline application of the technique.

src/features/studio/studioStore.ts:242 A runtime is keyed by project id, but its state is split across phase, busy, autonomous and resumeAuto. Writers poke those fields through a generic patch, with no transition door and no edge rules.

src/features/studio/studioStore.ts:310 Open tabs are mirrored and rehydrate re-attaches dev servers (line 772). An in-flight build turn is not mirrored, though, so after a mid-turn WebView reload the tab comes back idle while the backend turn may still be running.

src/features/studio/studioStore.ts:809 Closing a tab is a one-shot, fire-and-forget stop. The adjacent comment admits a server that refuses to die keeps its port with nothing in Studio pointing at it, and no convergence pass reaps it.
src/features/studio/studioStore.ts:722 Tier one comes from session stream events. Tier two is a liveness heartbeat with a two-miss rule (lines 487-513) plus a bounded boot poll.
src/features/studio/studioStore.ts:635 A failed turn turns autonomy off and records the cause, so the chain stops and escalates instead of retrying.
src/features/studio/studioStore.ts:46 The tabs are independent projects. Nothing fans out into a run roster that would need harvesting.
src/features/studio/studioStore.ts:584 Each turn goes to one build session. No panel of models is convened.
src/features/studio/studioStore.ts:48 Executors are local Rust-managed processes. There is no remote executor plane.
